_note: Extra subtask-B examples (both accept, agreement judge = 0) to balance C3 vs C5. One episode per run, from runs outside the 30 combined runs. C3 = both agents announce acceptance or explicitly agree to accept in the chat; C5 = no such announcement on both sides. Quotes are verbatim channel messages. borderline = 1 marks calls a second annotator should check.
